messages.subject: YouTube channel containing introductory lectures
parts:
For those of you just coming to distance sampling, or for those of you
who have colleagues or students who are new to distance sampling, we
have created a set of videos on a YouTube channel.
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKsykpR_drHXwXdJbR76YDw

The intention of the videos is to introduce the concepts and assumptions
of distance sampling. All together there are ~10 videos totalling
perhaps ~2 hours of content. Have a look at the play-list, showing the
sequence in which to view the videos. Over time we intend to expand
upon these offerings. Let us know your impressions.

--
